ShortDescription.Value: Read-only performance monitoring with optional experimental city-loading budget tuning. No visual-quality changes.

Publish.LongDescription:
BETA — performance monitoring, not a guaranteed FPS boost.
WHAT IT DOES Samples FPS and available frame-time/draw counters. Main-thread time includes waits and rendering work; these readings do not prove that simulation is the bottleneck.
HOW TO USE Open FT on the top-left toolbar. Options → FastTrack controls monitoring and logging. Pause persists until you enable it again.
CURRENT LIMITATIONS FastTrack changes nothing by default. The optional adaptive LOD (off by default, experimental) lowers the game's native LOD distance only at aerial views and never below the stock Low value; it does not change shadows, render scale, terrain, effects, culling or simulation. Experimental loading boost is OFF by default and only adjusts upload budgets during city loading; a speedup is not guaranteed. Leave it off when investigating GPU problems. Unsupported profiler counters show as unavailable. Extended in-game regression testing is still pending.
Publish.ChangeLog:
1.3.5-beta.2 — Opt-in adaptive LOD (experimental)
Adds an opt-in, off-by-default camera-aware LOD adjustment: it lowers the game's own LOD distance at aerial views, restores full detail at close views, and never goes below the stock Low value or a lower value you already set. Performance gain and visual impact have not been benchmarked in-game.
1.3.5-beta.1 — Maintenance beta: fixed persistent Pause and repeated restore writes, corrected settings registration and unavailable-counter handling, loading-budget tuning is an explicit opt-in.
Build/offline checks do not establish full in-game verification.
